metadata.construction: r_jb_universal = mean over 5 classes of (mean(h_jb_class) - mean(h_bare)) at pos=-2; r_jb points TOWARD jailbreak (Ball 2024 / Wang 2025 convention).
metadata.limitation_per_class: Per-class r_jb_class interventions would be more rigorous (applied only to their own class's JB-comply prompts) and are deferred. See HANDOFF.md.
metadata.convention_note: Sign convention flipped 2026-05-04 from r_jb = bare - jb (points toward refusal) to r_jb = jb - bare (points toward jailbreak; matches Ball 2024 / Wang 2025). All flip rates are unchanged — the experiments tested the same residual displacement, just with relabeled hooks. Under the new convention: Experiment A SUBTRACTS r_jb from JB-comply (mitigates the JB shift) → flips to refuse; Experiment B ADDS r_jb to bare-refuse (induces the JB shift) → flips to comply.

experiment_a_mitigate_jb_subtract_rjb.description: SUBTRACT r_jb_universal at L15 every forward pass, on jb_* prompts where Stage 06 baseline=COMPLY. (Equivalent to the previous 'add r_jb_old' under the flipped sign convention.) Tests whether removing the empirical jailbreak displacement reverses jailbreak success.
